summary: Implemented all 23 stubs in parsel/selector.py (Selector and SelectorList query, extraction, regex, namespace and removal methods) plus the root and parser helpers they need, including JSON auto-detection and parsing of markup strings returned by jmespath. The last full-suite run showed 336 passed and 5 failed: test_selector.py::test_re fails because utils.extract_regex returns None for an unmatched named group, and the other four failures are in csstranslator (css2xpath output) and docs/usage.rst doctests.
